summary: You can feel entirely certain that a situation is wrong without having a single actionable clue about how to fix it.
body: You can feel entirely certain that a situation is wrong without having a single actionable clue about how to fix it. When Mars conjuncts Neptune, high emotional conviction meets a total lack of a blueprint, leaving you ready to fight for an objective that keeps shifting shape. Pushing harder will not make a vague target clear. Define the actual problem, establish what is within your control, and pick one concrete step that actually moves the needle instead of just burning off nervous energy.
